programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E2
programme.desc: Hanna grows suspicious as Pram hides behind mysterious calls and lies. When he cancels plans with Karin for Hanna, jealousy sparks. Meanwhile, Naomi faces chaos after Niko mimics Daniel’s foul words, leading to a heated clash.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E3
programme.desc: Hanna’s world shatters when she finds a mini skirt in Pram’s car, sparking suspicion of betrayal. As she digs deeper, Daniel’s harshness fueled by work mistakes pushes Naomi into an even darker corner of her marriage.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E4
programme.desc: Rossa urges Hanna to take a break, but Pram’s constant busyness keeps them apart. Meanwhile, Hanna discovers Dini’s fake pregnancy, while Naomi’s crumbling marriage drives her to leave with Niko despite Daniel’s pursuit.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E5
programme.desc: Hanna grows doubtful of Pram’s constant lies about his Bali trip and starts seeking proof. Meanwhile, Dini shelters Asri after she’s evicted, but soon feels her role as wife threatened by Asri’s growing presence at home.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E6
programme.desc: Hanna invites Karin to her podcast, hoping she admits her affair with Pram. Though hesitant, Karin needs CHSI’s promotion for her campus event. Meanwhile, Naomi and Niko try to start fresh, yet Daniel’s shadow still lingers.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E7
programme.desc: Hanna confronts Pram with proof of his affair. While he promises change, the scandal with Karin goes viral, threatening Hanna’s brand deal. Karin faces online hate, losing her reputation and scholarship, just as Vino’s mother shows up at his house where Asri still hides as Dini’s maid.

programme.title: Catatan Hati Seorang Istri S1 E8
programme.desc: Tensions rise as Hanna faces reporters while Daniel falls back into violence, hurting Naomi and Niko. Naomi flees with her son and seeks divorce. As Asri disappears and Karin storms into CHSI, Hanna plots to protect her name.

programme.desc: Compostman et Moi is a documentary that explores the growing movement toward sustainable living through the work of Florian Bonnet, better known as "Compostman." Along the way, the film highlights environmental challenges, community initiatives, and the positive impact that individual actions can have on building a more sustainable future.

programme.desc: After being abducted and locked in a basement, a boy starts receiving calls on a disconnected phone from the killer's previous victims.

programme.desc: A man once called a bowling legend teams up with a bookie and an autistic genius bowling player.

programme.title: Hannibal

programme.title: Cape Fear
programme.desc: A convicted rapist, released from prison after serving a fourteen-year sentence, stalks the family of the lawyer who originally defended him.

programme.desc: A college student must relive the day of her murder over and over again, in a loop that will end only when she discovers her killer's identity.

programme.title: Happy Death Day 2U
programme.desc: Tree Gelbman discovers that dying over and over was surprisingly easier than the dangers that lie ahead.

programme.title: Us
programme.desc: In order to get away from their busy lives, the Wilson family takes a vacation to Santa Cruz, California. At night, four strangers break into Adelaide's childhood home. The family is shocked to find out that the intruders look like them.

programme.title: Halloween
programme.desc: Laurie Strode confronts her long-time foe, Michael Myers, the masked figure who has haunted her since she narrowly escaped his killing spree on Halloween night four decades ago.

programme.title: Halloween Kills
programme.desc: Surviving victims of Michael Myers form a vigilante mob and vow to end his reign of terror.

programme.title: Dracula Untold
programme.desc: As his kingdom is being threatened by the Turks, young prince Vlad Tepes must become a monster feared by his own people in order to obtain the power needed to protect his own family, and the families of his kingdom.

programme.title: The Skeleton Key
programme.desc: A hospice nurse working at a spooky New Orleans plantation home finds herself entangled in a mystery involving the house's dark past.

programme.title: Us
programme.desc: In order to get away from their busy lives, the Wilson family takes a vacation to Santa Cruz, California. At night, four strangers break into Adelaide's childhood home. The family is shocked to find out that the intruders look like them.

programme.title: Happy Death Day
programme.desc: A college student must relive the day of her murder over and over again, in a loop that will end only when she discovers her killer's identity.

programme.title: Death Becomes Her
programme.desc: Two women are determined to win the heart of the same man, when they both drink an immortality potion, their mutual murder plans get a little complicated!

programme.title: Morphle
programme.desc: Mila's dad runs the only magic pet store in the city - a fantastical place where you can find all sorts of cute and quirky pets who each have their own unique magic powers, and he has gifted Mila the most magic pet of all, Morphle.

programme.title: WAKAKIBO KIDS
programme.desc: AT THE BASE OF BANANA MOUNTAIN, RIGHT ON THE EDGE OF A FANTASY TROPICAL FOREST FILLED WITH VARIOUS CUTE AND ADORABLE ANIMALS, LIES THE VILLAGE WHERE OUR TWO FRIENDS LIVE: WAKA AND KIBO. WAKA, A CHILD WHO LOVES TO EAT AND LOOKS LIKE A SLOW CHILD, IS ACTUALLY VERY CAREFUL AND ALWAYS THINKING BEFORE HE ACTS. ON THE OTHER HAND, KIBO, WITH HIS THICK, CURRY HAIR, IS A CHEERFUL FIGURE, ALWAYS CURIOS, AND EASY TO MAKE FRIENDS WITH ANYONE. UNLIKE WAKA, KIBO OFTEN ACTS WITHOUT THINKING FIRST. THE STORY OF FRIENDSHIP BETWEEN WAKA AND KIBO IN THEIR VILLAGE FULL OF COLOUR AND LIFE TAKES US ON ENTERTAINING AND FASCINATING ADVENTURES, WHERE THESE TWO CHARACTERS LEARN FROM THEIR DIFFERENCES AND COMPLEMENT EACH OTHER.
